#Module fetch

The promise side of the Fetch API, on the same records as the callback API of module net (a Response is a Fetch: Fetch_status, Fetch_headers, Fetch_release... apply to it).

  • Fetch_promise settles with the Response when the headers arrive; it is rejected on a network error (Network) or an abort (the signal's reason).
  • Response_text / Response_arrayBuffer settle when the whole body is there; a body is consumed once (bodyUsed).
  • Response_body is a minimal ReadableStream: Stream_read settles with a buffer of what arrived since the last read, or with 0 (text "done") at the end; Stream_cancel stops the download.
  • An abort signal cancels the request and fails it with error kind Aborted.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/fetch.widl.

#Types

#handle ReadableStream : Object

The body of a response being read in chunks.

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_ReadableStream).

#Functions

#Fetch_promise

Promise<Response> Fetch_promise(string url, string method = "GET", string headers = "", optional bytes body, optional Buffer body_buffer, optional AbortSignal signal, FetchOptions options = none) raises

fetch(url, init): the body is body, or the bytes of body_buffer when given. Type when the signal is not an AbortSignal or the buffer not a buffer.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fetch_promise :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string, method: string, headers: string, body: Maybe([]u8), body_buffer: Api_Buffer, signal: Api_AbortSignal, options: Api_FetchOptions) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Fetch_startWithSignal

Fetch Fetch_startWithSignal(string url, FetchCallback callback, i32 user = 0, string method = "GET", string headers = "", optional bytes body, optional Buffer body_buffer, optional AbortSignal signal, FetchOptions options = none) raises

The callback API (Fetch_start) with an abort signal and an optional buffer body.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fetch_startWithSignal :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string, callback: u32, user: i32, method: string, headers: string, body: Maybe([]u8), body_buffer: Api_Buffer, signal: Api_AbortSignal, options: Api_FetchOptions) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Fetch_sync

Fetch Fetch_sync(string url, string method = "GET", string headers = "", optional bytes body, FetchOptions options = none, u32 timeout_ms = 0) raises

A synchronous XMLHttpRequest of a worker: the request Fetch_startWithSignal would make, waited for on the worker's thread; the finished record (read it with Fetch_status, Fetch_headers, Fetch_readBody..., then release it). Not_Supported in a document (its thread is the page's), Timeout past timeout_ms (0: none), Network on a failure.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Fetch_sync :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string, method: string, headers: string, body: Maybe([]u8), options: Api_FetchOptions, timeout_ms: u32) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Response_text

Promise<string> Response_text(Response response)

response.text(): settles with the text (decoded as UTF-8) in the promise's text, its length as value. A callback fetch can be read once it is done (Invalid_State before).

Host: Response_text :: proc(c: ^Call, response: Api_Fetch) -> u64

#Response_arrayBuffer

Promise<Buffer> Response_arrayBuffer(Response response)

response.arrayBuffer(): settles with a buffer.

Host: Response_arrayBuffer :: proc(c: ^Call, response: Api_Fetch) -> u64

#Response_bytes

Promise<Buffer> Response_bytes(Response response)

response.bytes(): the same as arrayBuffer on this platform.

Host: Response_bytes :: proc(c: ^Call, response: Api_Fetch) -> u64

#Response_bodyUsed

bool Response_bodyUsed(Response response)

response.bodyUsed

Host: Response_bodyUsed :: proc(c: ^Call, response: Api_Fetch) -> bool

#Response_body

ReadableStream Response_body(Response response) raises

response.body: the body as a stream. Type when the body was used already.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Response_body :: proc(c: ^Call, response: Api_Fetch) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Stream_read

Promise<Buffer> Stream_read(ReadableStream stream)

reader.read(): settles with a buffer, or with 0 at the end.

Host: Stream_read :: proc(c: ^Call, stream: Api_ReadableStream) -> u64

#Stream_cancel

void Stream_cancel(ReadableStream stream)

reader.cancel(): the download stops, waiting reads settle with "done".

Host: Stream_cancel :: proc(c: ^Call, stream: Api_ReadableStream)

#Fetch_startFormData

Fetch Fetch_startFormData(string url, FormData data, FetchCallback callback, i32 user = 0, string method = "POST", string headers = "", FormEnctype enctype = Multipart, FetchOptions options = none)

fetch with a FormData body: the Content-Type (with its boundary) is set unless headers name one. Same callback and options as Fetch_start.

Host: Fetch_startFormData :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string, data: Api_FormData, callback: u32, user: i32, method: string, headers: string, enctype: Api_FormEnctype, options: Api_FetchOptions) -> u64
